name: TemplateMethod
summary: Defines the skeleton of an algorithm in an operation, deferring some steps to subclasses so they can redefine them without changing the algorithm's structure.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: AbstractClass
roles.summary: Defines the skeleton of the algorithm, and declares the steps subclasses must supply.

roles.name: ConcreteClass
roles.summary: Supplies the steps the algorithm defers to subclasses.

roles.name: TemplateMethod
roles.summary: The operation that holds the skeleton of the algorithm, and calls the deferred steps.

roles.name: PrimitiveOperation
roles.summary: A step the algorithm defers, and which subclasses must supply.

roles.name: HookOperation
roles.summary: A step the algorithm defers, and which subclasses may override, but need not.
